column2: An old Victorian brick sewer wall plastered with layers of stamped and watermarked entry permits, customs forms and luggage tags, rusty pipes, dripping wet patina, a painted line that says ARRIVALS.

A white subway tile wall with a green tile band, covered in grease stained hand drawn pilgrimage maps, prayer candles in bottle caps on a ledge, pizza box lid paintings, small framed shrine pictures of a heroic rat carrying a slice.

A wet aquarium room wall of glass blocks and teal tile painted with fake pastoral murals of red barns, cows and green upstate farmland, real water stains, little framed photos of goldfish families, an UPSTATE sign.

A curved red brick tunnel wall covered with framed yellowed newspaper clippings and repeated corrections, art deco brass sconces, green velvet wainscot, a small framed photo of an alligator in a top hat.
A wall of translucent amber and ivory congealed fat lit from behind like alabaster, marbled with takeaway receipts, fossilised plastic forks, butter wrappers and noodles like a cathedral stone.

A trading pit wall covered with paper charts of volatile crumb prices, green and red ticker tape, chalkboards of numbers, flour dust, brass clocks showing different boroughs, bakery tickets pinned in rows.

A wall of grey steel shelving packed with tagged lost property: umbrellas, single gloves, earbuds, keys, sunglasses, transit cards, each with a white paper claim ticket on string, a stencilled sign that says LOST.
An ornate Victorian wall of patent diagrams of pneumatic tubes and fans in gold frames, red flocked wallpaper, brass gas lamps, polished mahogany wainscot with brass rivets.
A spa wall of sweating pink and teal ceramic tile with peeling framed wellness certificates, brass steam valves, white towels on hooks, condensation streaks, eucalyptus sprigs.
A curved wall of cream and green Guastavino vault tile with a long bulletin board of handwritten meeting minutes, agendas and notices pinned in rows, brass plaques.
A bodega basement wall of stacked cardboard cases of soda and cereal, handwritten cardboard signs refusing credit, a corkboard of lottery tickets, a cat calendar, a bare light bulb glow.
A wall of white porcelain tile and rusted iron pipes, pinned with lease renewals and rent notices, gilt framed portraits of crowned rats, a red velvet drape.
